mapper.select:
SELECT t.term_id AS termsId, t.term_code AS termsCode, t.term_name AS termsName, t.is_required AS required, t.term_status AS termsStatus, tv.term_version_id AS termsVersionId, tv.version AS version, tv.content AS content, tv.effective_started_at AS effectiveStartedAt FROM term t INNER JOIN term_version tv ON t.term_id = tv.term_id WHERE t.term_status = 'ACTIVE'
AND tv.effective_started_at <= NOW() AND ( tv.effective_ended_at IS NULL OR tv.effective_ended_at > NOW() )
ORDER BY t.is_required DESC, t.term_id ASC
